function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what you’re looking for:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|
| **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide or local delivery, custom designs, same‑day options | Visit their website or app (e.g., **Goldbelly**, **Etsy**, **Amazon Fresh**, **Instacart** for local bakeries) | Check delivery times, read reviews, and confirm the cake’s size & flavor. |
| **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often handmade, personalized service | Google “cake shop near me” or use Yelp/TripAdvisor to find top-rated spots. Call or visit their website. | Ask about custom orders, allergies, and delivery fees. |
| **Supermarket bakery sections** | Convenient, usually cheaper, ready‑made or simple custom orders | Check the bakery aisle or the store’s online ordering portal (e.g., **Walmart Grocery**, **Kroger**, **Whole Foods**). | Some supermarkets offer same‑day pickup or delivery via their grocery apps. |
| **Specialty dessert shops** | Unique flavors, artistic designs, often vegan or gluten‑free options | Search for “artisan cake shop” or “specialty bakery” in your city. | Great for themed parties or gifts—ask about packaging and shipping. |
| **Catering companies** | Full-service event planning, large orders, décor | Look up local catering firms; many include cake options. | Ideal for weddings, corporate events, or large gatherings. |
| **DIY kits** | Fun, interactive, can be delivered to your door | Sites like **Bakeology**, **Patisserie** or local craft stores sell kits. | Good for a personal touch or a family activity. |

### Quick Steps to Order

1. **Decide on the occasion** (birthday, wedding, corporate event, etc.) and the cake size.
2. **Choose a flavor & design** (classic vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, custom toppers, etc.).
3. **Pick a vendor**: use one of the options above or ask friends for recommendations.
4. **Place the order**: most sites let you customize the cake, choose delivery/pickup, and pay online.
5. **Confirm details**: double‑check the delivery address, time, and any special instructions (e.g., “no sugar” or “vegan”).

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up a list of highly rated local bakeries or delivery services that are right around you. Happy cake hunting! 🍰
